title: American Sign Language
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: American Sign Language, Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the Certificate of Achievement in American Sign Language, students will be able to demonstrate conversational proficiency in ASL, apply knowledge of Deaf culture and community norms in appropriate contexts, and effectively communicate with Deaf and Hard of Hearing individuals in educational, professional, and community settings.
Students will also be able to recognize the ethical considerations and professional standards relevant to sign language interpretation and related fields.
Acquired fundamental understanding of the principles and practices of American Sign Language
careers: working with Deaf and Hard of Hearing individuals
entry-level positions assisting Deaf and Hard of Hearing individuals

notes: The closed list writes ASL132 and ASL135 without a space; they were matched to the catalog's ASL 132 and ASL 135 and not flagged as catalog additions.
The page states 'Credits: 16' and 'Required Core Courses - Total 16 Credits'; recorded as 16 units.

The first outcome embeds its lead-in ('Upon successful completion ... students will be able to') in the same sentence, and the second begins 'Students will also be able to'. Both were kept whole as printed rather than cut mid-sentence.

Careers include occupations named as professionals who might take the program for continuing education (teachers, nurses, emergency service personnel). A reviewer may wish to confirm whether these should count as careers.
